description: Each version's planner request against an oracle: openpilot's unchanged radard + planner fed a hindsight reference lead (identity from the in-path ACC target, else the camera; range from the ACC target, else the raw object list within 1 m lateral, plus the camera when on the same car; Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoothing within each stretch of one car, split at range jumps, ACC-target ID changes and lateral jumps > 1.5 m), through an interface that publishes only that lead. Owner 2.1 road drives and a second car's two drives, open loop.

definitions.unnecessary: request below the oracle's by > 0.5 m/s2 for >= 0.3 s
definitions.missed: oracle <= -1 m/s2 while the version > -0.5 for >= 0.3 s
definitions.confident: reference from the radar (ACC target or object list), radar and camera agree, and not within 2 s after the ACC target dropped a lead the camera still follows (a lead turning out of the lane); camera-only moments are judged with video, not scored; the car moving (>= 1 m/s): at standstill the planner's stop-and-go logic dominates and an object seen only by the ACC target may be a car or a wall

turning_lead_case: video and optical looming: the in-lane lead slowed to turn off (about -3 m/s at 105-115 m) then left the lane; 2.1 braked -1.54 m/s2 for a car a lane over whose radar speed read a false -7 m/s; 2.3 -0.29; vision -0.08

suite_34_drives.note: the 34 replay drives (20 held-out, 4 further, 3 owner); 4 chains have no lead data in their logs and are not scored

note_2_4: 2.4 = 2.3 without the radar's target summaries (the openpilot version's filter)
